note: Confirmation layer over MSU_Eligibility_Rules.json (read by src/eligibility_engine.py). It never relaxes or tightens a rule silently: for advert wording that can be read in more than one way it records a STRICT reading and a LENIENT reading. An applicant who meets the strict reading gets a verified match whichever reading MSU intends; one who meets only the lenient reading gets a conditional match with the open question shown. Questions here are for MSU Admissions; they are not decided by this file. Review: 2026-10-16, AI-assisted, not an MSU decision.
